packageRules.description: a bytes merge redeploys prod: the nightly patches pr merges only in dima's day, 07:00–18:59 Kyiv, wide on purpose: renovate wakes 6–8 h apart, and a wake that rebases needs a second wake to merge. platformAutomerge off, or github queues the merge when the pr opens at night and the window is ignored (renovate's automergeSchedule docs)
graphql held on 16 in the space-explorer pair: @apollo/server 5.5.1 peers graphql ^16.11; lift this the day an @apollo/server release accepts 17 (2026-10-28)

rebase a renovate pr only on a conflict: the default rebased every open pr on every wake once main moved, each one regenerating pnpm-lock.yaml (~2 min), so five open prs made a 10 min run (BYT-135). main's protection does not require an up-to-date branch, so a stale green pr still merges
